messages:
amy.sales: Quick heads-up — FinCorp just asked if we can do BYO-CMK with an HSM-backed customer KEK in private deployment. They want dual-custodian (split KEK), offline key ceremony + rotation every 4 hours. They said procurement will stall without an ops runbook and cost delta. cc @matt.engineering @oliver.crypto

matt.engineering: We support BYO-CMK and can integrate with customer HSMs in Private. Offline ceremony + split custody is operationally fine but not turnkey — SOW + runbook needed. 4h rotation is unusual, will surface perf + availability impacts.

oliver.crypto: 4h rotation is a red flag. Frequent rotations invalidate KV caches and short-circuit prefix caches -> higher latency and token cost. Recommend either: 
- use envelope encryption where the data key changes less frequently and the KEK rotates (wrap/unwrap) or 
- if customers insist on 4h KEK rotations, scope a custom caching + rewrap path.

cassandra.ps: From PS angle — we need a key-ceremony checklist and roles (custodian A/B, Redwood ops observer, security witness), windows for handoff, and a dry-run. Also need boilerplate SOW language for dedicated engineering time + on-call support. Is there an estimated uplift?

matt.engineering: rough numbers: for Private + HSM integration + 2-week POC + custom rotation cadence: expect ~2-3 FTE-weeks engineering, add 40-80 hours of PS during cutover, and ~+25-40% on Dedicated capacity pricing depending on throughput. Will confirm with finance.

oliver.crypto: Ops-wise: we must update our KV cache TTL strategy and add a rewrap daemon to avoid large tail latencies on rotation events. Also need to define rollback semantics if a custody key is lost during ceremony. Suggest we require an escrow + documented rollback playbook.

amy.sales: Customer explicitly asked for rollback proof points (legal wants to see failback steps). Can we produce a one-pager that covers: architecture diagram, rotation flow, rollback steps, security attestations, and cost impact?

matt.engineering: I can draft the architecture + a sample curl for rotation calls. Example for proposal (POC):
```
# sample rotation trigger (POC only)
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.internal/v1/keys/rotate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" \n  -d '{"key_id":"cmk-abc123","rotation_mode":"handoff","custodians":["A","B"]}'
```
This will kick the rewrap flow and emit events to the tracing pipeline.

devsec-bot: Security questionnaire pointer: https://redwood.internal/docs/byok/key-ceremony-runbook — includes list of required artefacts (key manifests, witness logs, HSM attestation format). :link:

oncall.ops: Operational notes: add these alerts before we sign: key-rotation-failure, rewrap-exceed-ttl, failed-custodian-ack. Estimate +16h/week of monitoring during first 2 weeks of rollout, then ongoing 2-4h/week. Cost uplift estimate: +30% OPEX for management & monitoring the first quarter.

cassandra.ps: Procurement/legal will also want: sample SOW addendum text and insurance language for key custody. I'll pull a template but need the engineering counts and timeline to finalize numbers.

amy.sales: Is this a hard deal blocker? FinCorp says procurement won't move without documented rollback and a timeline.

oliver.crypto: Not an absolute blocker — we can do it — but it requires: SOW addendum, 2-week POC integration, runbook + escrow process, and a slightly higher price. Also need customer to accept maintenance windows for ceremonies.

amy.sales: Ok — I'll tell FinCorp: we can support their requirements but need a 2-week POC and SOW addendum; send us the HSM attestation format and expected rotation SLAs. Please prioritize runbook + cost estimates. Will schedule customer call tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:

matt.engineering: I'll produce the one-pager + rough numbers by EOD. tagging @oliver.crypto for review.

oliver.crypto: I'll review and add the rollback playbook and required attestations.

cassandra.ps: I'll draft SOW language and cost paragraph after Matt shares numbers.

amy.sales: Thanks team — if we can get the one-pager + SOW bullets today, I can unblock procurement tomorrow.
